_doc: Registry of deployed contracts on TPIX Chain (4289). Keep in sync after each deploy. Feeds scripts/verify-sources.js and external explorers/aggregators.

chain.name: TPIX Chain
chain._rpcNote: rpc.tpix.online sits behind a Cloudflare bot rule that 403s clients without a browser-like User-Agent. rpc1.tpix.online has no such rule and answers every client — see masternode-ui/electron/rpc-client.js.
chain._genesisNote: The chain was re-genesised on 2026-08-06 and moved to a new host. All contract state from before that date was discarded.

notes.howToAdd: After deploying a new contract, append { name, address, sourceFile, compilerVersion, optimizer, description, verified: false } to `contracts` and run `npm run verify:sources`. The script updates `verified: true` on success.
notes.howToVerifyItIsReal: curl -s -X POST <rpc> -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_getCode","params":["<address>","latest"],"id":1}' — anything other than 0x means the contract exists.
notes.aggregators: CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, DeFiLlama, and CEX listings all check source verification status on the block explorer — keep this file up to date.
